'''Horell''', nicknamed '''The Black Death''' by the inhabitants of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he held the job of senior administrator within the company and took a vacation to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Hutta. On Hutta, he began hunting the native [[Evocii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for sport, earning himself his nickname among the Evocii due to the [[Color/Legends|color]] of his hunting gear. A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Var'soonta]], who traded salvage to the Evocii, asked an Imperial-aligned individual to persuade Horell to stop killing his customers, and the individual found the Black Death's speeder and destroyed several of his [[The Black Death's hunting droids|droids]]. When the hunter confronted the individual, however, he was able to bribe them to leave him alone. Unlike most other Czerka staff of his time, he wore the previous black and yellow color scheme on his uniform, rather than the far more common green and yellow.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's some crazy rich guy running around shooting Evocii. Big pain in the neck.|Var'soonta|<ref name="Trophy" />}}
Horell was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] senior administrator of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="Trophy" /> During the war, in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he took a vacation to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Trophy" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> On Hutta, he began hunting the native [[Evocii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for sport, earning himself the name "Black Death" among his prey due to the [[Color/Legends|black]] hunting gear he wore. He hunted in the swamps close to an [[Voam|Evocii work camp]] near [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="Trophy" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> While hunting, the administrator traveled in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] with a number of [[The Black Death's hunting droids|hunting droids]], whom he left to guard his speeder while he hunted. Initially, the Black Death only hunted rebellious Evocii, but soon turned to killing any he could find, including those from the work camp. From each Evocii he killed, he took their [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] as trophies.<ref name="Trophy" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
[[File:Black_Death_speeder_and_droids.jpg|thumb|left|The Black Death's speeder and droids|250px]]
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] salvage dealer called [[Var'soonta]], who ran a store in the work camp, offered to pay an Imperial-aligned individual visiting the shop to persuade the Black Death to stop killing Evocii, as it was bad for his business. The individual found the hunter's speeder<ref name="Trophy" /> and destroyed at least six of his droids,<ref name="Party">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Hunting Party|Hutta}}</ref> drawing his attention. The Black Death rushed to the speeder to stop the individual from destroying any more of his property. Outraged, he demanded to know what the individual wanted and when they claimed to be there to stop him killing Evocii, he refused to believe them, claiming no one cared enough about the Evocii to do so. He then offered to pay the individual to leave him alone so he could continue to hunt, which the individual accepted. The administrator paid the individual 122 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as well as a Nal Hutta commendation and some gear, after which the individual left and the hunter returned to hunting.<ref name="Trophy" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We both know Evocii are no better than akk dogs. So stop pretending this is about them.|The Black Death|<ref name="Trophy" />}}
The Black Death considered the Evocii he hunted to be equivalent to non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species such as [[Akk dog/Legends|Akk dogs]],<ref name="Trophy" /> which could also be found in Nal Hutta's swamps.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Due to this, he had no moral issue with hunting them and did not believe that any other being could possibly have one either. He was greatly angered by the destruction of his property, but chose to pay those responsible to leave him alone rather than attack them. He was reasonably cowardly and, if threatened with physical violence, was quick to surrender. He also held great respect and fear for Nem'ro the Hutt. The Black Death had pale skin, black hair and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Trophy" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|You're looking for a vehicle out in the swamps, surrounded by security droids. The Black Death guy doesn't like visitors.|Var'soonta|<ref name="Trophy" />}}
The Black Death owned a number of hunting [[Droid/Legends|droids]], which he took with him while he hunted, to guard a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] he owned and used for transport in the swamps of Hutta. While hunting, he wore black and yellow hunting gear and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|Blaster rifle]] on his back.<ref name="Trophy" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I will cease my holiday immediately and pack up my camp site at once. Please give Nem'ro my apologies.|The Black Death's dialogue if the player persuades him to stop hunting.|<ref name="Trophy" />}}
The Black Death first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] classes, where he is involved in the quest "Trophy Hunter", in which player is asked to stop him from hunting Evocii. The player has the "[[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]" option of accepting credits to leave the hunter alone, or the "[[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]" option of refusing his money. If they choose the "light side" option, they are given another choice, to kill him as a "dark side" option or to tell him Nem'ro is angry with him, causing him to flee the planet, as a "light side" option. This article assumes the player chose the first "dark side" option, as only players of the Bounty Hunter and Imperial Agent class can take this quest and both are Imperials, assumed to have full "dark side" alignment.
